scripts.test:corpus: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="^(the one official trailing-PNG exception|signature extraction returns only|signature extraction trusts|exact API names rank|runtime accepts|topic content validation|source filters|v1\.1 expansions|status and related|raw FTS|read supports focus|service handlers|database is read-only|CButton image associations|portable stdio MCP)" tests/image-indexer-v12.test.mjs tests/indexer-v11.test.mjs tests/service.test.mjs tests/mcp.test.mjs
